question: Where can I get the list of grid connection requests in the United States, with project, technology, capacity (MW), connection node, status and date?

answer.summary: There is no single official national list: each ISO/RTO publishes its own. MISO (JSON), CAISO and NYISO (Excel) were downloaded and give technology, MW, POI, status and dates; only NYISO names developers. PJM has a web viewer with export links not tested; SPP, ISO-NE, ERCOT not retrieved. Berkeley Lab's Queued Up compilation (7 ISOs plus ~50 non-ISO areas) was blocked here.
main_caveats: Operator lists are regional and use different fields, MW bases and status codes; do not add them up as a national total.
A connection request does not prove permits, financing or construction.
MISO and CAISO omit developer names; NYISO status is a numeric code without legend.
Withdrawn and done requests sit in the same files as active ones; filter by status before counting.
The MISO JSON endpoint is undocumented and no licence was found for any operator file.
answer.confidence_reason: Three operators in different regions were downloaded and inspected; PJM, SPP, ISO-NE, ERCOT, non-ISO utilities and the compilation were not read.

attributes.note: NYISO names developer and project; CAISO gives project names; MISO only a request number.
attributes.gap_note: MISO and CAISO files tested do not publish developer; PJM rows not read; non-ISO utilities not examined.

attributes.note: MISO fuelType/facilityType, CAISO up to three fuels with MW, NYISO fuel code.
attributes.gap_note: PJM, SPP, ISO-NE, ERCOT and non-ISO utilities not read; LBNL compilation blocked.

attributes.note: Summer/winter or POI MW; bases differ (MISO net summer/winter, CAISO per fuel and POI, NYISO SP/WP).
attributes.gap_note: Other operators not read; MW bases are not harmonised and are undocumented.

attributes.note: Single POI field: MISO poiName (3,746 of 4,101 filled), CAISO POI, NYISO Points of Interconnection.
attributes.gap_note: Tested files do not separate requested from assigned node; MISO leaves POI empty on about 355 records.

attributes.note: MISO applicationStatus; CAISO active vs Withdrawn sheets; NYISO numeric Project Status # without legend.
attributes.gap_note: No queue position in MISO or CAISO; NYISO and MISO status codes undefined; suspended not isolated.

attributes.note: Queue, application, withdrawal and requested in-service dates; NYISO Date of IR and Last Updated.
attributes.gap_note: Meaning of each date differs by operator; PJM dates not visible in capture; other operators not read.

attributes.note: MISO live on 2026-11-19 (latest queueDate 2026-11-03); CAISO C16 posted 2026-10-16; NYISO 2026-10-31; LBNL through 2025.
attributes.gap_note: No national file is current to the month; lag differs per operator.

attributes.note: NYISO withdrawn back to 1999; MISO records from 2015; LBNL annual editions (not opened).
attributes.gap_note: No dated snapshots from operators were found; CAISO holds one file per cluster; LBNL content not verified.

attributes.note: MISO cache about 5 minutes (observed); CAISO per cluster; PJM statistics PDFs semiannual; none states record cadence.
attributes.gap_note: No tested operator states how often request records are updated.

sources.name: MISO generator interconnection queue (JSON endpoint behind the Project Status tool)
sources.summary: Full MISO queue as JSON: 4,101 requests with status, fuel, MW, POI, TO, state and dates; no developer names.
sources.coverage_note: MISO footprint only (one of seven ISO/RTOs); not a national list.
caveats: No developer or project name; Done and LEGACY statuses undefined.

problems: Endpoint is not documented on the landing page; found by testing the Project Status tool's data path. HEAD returns 405 while GET returns 200.
No licence or terms of use found for the data.

sources.name: CAISO generator interconnection queue reports (Cluster 16 and Cluster 15 Excel files)
sources.format: XLSX (one workbook per cluster; Cluster 15 has Active and Withdrawn sheets)
sources.summary: Per-cluster Excel files with project name, fuels and MW, POI, county, requested COD and queue/application dates.
sources.coverage_note: CAISO only; the two latest clusters (15 and 16) were tested, older ones sit in RIMS.
caveats: No developer name and no status column in Cluster 16.
Cluster files are not cumulative; Excel serial dates.

problems: Each cluster is a separate file; no cumulative queue file was found in the page text.
No licence or terms found for the files.

sources.summary: NYISO workbook with developer, project, MW, fuel, POI, status code and dates; active, cluster, withdrawn and in-service sheets.

sources.name: PJM Cycle and Serial Service Request Status pages
sources.format: HTML table with XLS/XML export links (export untested); PDFs
sources.summary: PJM publishes request lists in a web viewer (cycle and serial pages) with XLS/XML export links; the viewer rows and exports were not read.
caveats: Export and sign-in requirement not verified.
TC2 moved from the serial to the cycle page.

problems: Request rows and exports were not retrieved: the pages are a script-driven viewer.
Whether the exports need a PJM account was not verified.

sources.name: Berkeley Lab Queued Up: interconnection queue data file (through 2025)
sources.publisher: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory with GridTracker
sources.format: XLSX (project-level dataset, codebook and 36 summary tabs per the publication page)
sources.summary: Annual multi-operator compilation of US generation queues through end-2025 (CC BY 4.0), covering ISO/RTOs and about 50 non-ISO areas.
sources.coverage_note: Per publisher; fields and records not verified because the file was blocked here.
caveats: File could not be downloaded from this environment (403).
Lags operator data by months; generation only.

problems: Automated requests to emp.lbl.gov and to the data-file URL on eta-publications.lbl.gov get a 403 challenge page; the landing page emp.lbl.gov/queues also returned 403 to curl.
Contents of the workbook not verified; description relies on the publication page.

if_unstructured.summary: Operator files and viewers are structured; no document-extraction recipe needed for the tested operators.

local_terms.meaning: Ordered list of generator requests to connect to the transmission grid.
Requested substation or line where the project would connect.
Energy Resource / Network Resource Interconnection Service (MISO svcType values).
MISO study cycle label such as DPP-2023.
Requests studied in batches (CAISO clusters, PJM Transition Cycles, NYISO cluster projects).
Independent System Operator or Regional Transmission Organization.
